decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit has its own product page, involved substantial engineering investment and fits the firm's announced injection and plural-component direction, so management would persist with it.
This second injection unit was also visibly committed to with its own page and is core to the firm's application-technology strategy, which makes dropping it costly to justify.
The automatic airless spray gun belongs to the firm's central spray-application range and was publicly showcased, so the sunk investment and visible commitment favor keeping it.
The manual airless gun is a core accessory line with its own page and steady spare-parts demand, so there is little reason to write off the commitment.
The air-assisted airless gun extends the core spray portfolio and was presented prominently, and any weak results can be attributed to temporary market conditions such as the 2020–2021 disruptions.

The data logger was reduced from its own page to a mere mention, signaling weaker commitment and a higher risk of being dropped, but it is a low-cost complement to existing equipment that management would likely still retain.
